title: DecisionFramework
description: A reusable typed DAG of decision forks solving a meta-problem: from initial_state_keys, an ordered set of forks whose state contracts (consumes/produces) chain to yield goal_state_keys. The decision-graph analogue of a solution_framework - the checker validates the fork order composes by the same wave rule (every consumed key produced by the initial state or an earlier fork). Generated by scripts/build_decision_frameworks_pack.py.
